The Plant shall be designed for firing natural gas (Gas).
The equipment shall include but not be limited to:
- Emergency shutdown valve
- Compressor station
- Filter Separator/Knock out drum
- Redundant Coalescing Filter/Moisture Separator (2x100%)
- Fuel gas metering (Main and Back-Up)
- Fuel gas conditioning
- Fuel gas performance heaters 1x100% for each Gas Turbine
- Dew Point Heater (if required)
- Condensate collection and disposal system
For the design and operation of the fuel Gas system, the following main constraints shall be considered:
- The fuel Gas system shall comply with the applicable standards like ASME, EN and API, as far as applicable.
- For the design, block and bleed approach shall be used.
- All the equipment shall be fitted with isolating valves to permit repair and maintenance without interrupting the Gas supply .
For each Gas Turbine, following equipment installed as related accessories will be provided as 100% x 1set, in hence, repair and maintenance without interrupting the gas supply is limited.
- GT Fuel gas flow meter and GT Fuel gas heater (Radiator type & Feed water type)
- All isolating valves shall be ball type with double block and bleed function.
- For Gas supply line inside Gas Turbine package, two (2) globe valves i.e. control valve and isolation valve with bleeding valve in-between are considered.
- Emergency shut-down (ESD) valves shall be used down-stream the Gas delivery point to allow the entire Gas supply to the plant to be isolated in the event of an emergency.
- ESD valves shall be 'fire -safe' in accordance with API -607 or BS-5146 and of anti-static design in accordance with BS-5351.
- Sufficient permanent installed valve connections and vents shall be provided to permit the gas system to be purged with inert gas.
- All butt welds shall be subject to 100% radiography test and all other welds shall be subject to 100% non-destructive testing. If socket welds are approved by design for small bore (DN 50 and below) pipe, 100% surface NDT shall be done i.e Magnetic Particle Testing (MPT) for ferritic steels and DPT for austenitic steels.
- •
- The maximum flow velocity for piping and valve dimensioning shall not be higher than 25 m/s. Inside Gas Turbine enclosure and related accessories, flow velocity is optimized as per OEM design standard.
- Buried gas pipes shall be adequately protected and insulated against the aggressive environment in which they are found

chunks.text:
Considering the applicability of the Fuel Gas Boosting Compressors, single failure of the Fuel Gas Boosting Compressors may lead to a loss of Plant output during the transient conditions (between the time of the trip until the full load of the standby compressor) however, this trip should not cause a trip within the Power Block. In order to design the Fuel Gas Buffer System, Contractor should consider the worst Fuel Gas receiving  conditions  and  Plant  Maximum  output  at  Reference  Site  Conditions  and  the  Gas  Turbines operating at maximum load. The configuration should provide no trip within Gas Turbine when a trip has occurred on a Gas Boosting Compressor at any Gas Supply conditions. EPC Contractor should consider the standby compressor startup time for Gas Turbine operating conditions. The fuel gas booster compressors shall be configured with IGVs for PR control (if required).  The fuel gas booster compressors shall be 2 sections,  serial  oriented  with  interstage  bypass.  When  the  fuel  gas  terminal  point  pressure  is  equal  or higher to reference gas pressure but lower than the gas turbine required inlet pressure, only section 2 will operate while section 1 will be fully by-passed but kept in hot standby. In case the fuel gas terminal point pressure is between minimum fuel gas terminal point pressure and reference fuel gas terminal pressure, both section 1 and section 2 will be in operation.
Gas turbines operating flow range, minimum flow considering single GT operation with minimum emission compliant  load  flow  as  well  as  maximum  flow  considering  Plant  Maximum  output  at  Reference  Site Conditions at new and clean / maximum GT Degradation case should be covered with selected Fuel Gas Booster Compressor flow ranges.
The plant shall include in its scope all the systems required for the provision of the gas pressure and quality required by its combustion equipment (e.g., reducing station, booster compressor, filtering, heating, fuel gas analyser (One Chromatograph for GRMS)).
An emergency shut-down ("ESD") valve shall be provided in each fuel stream to isolate the fuel supply to the plant and shall meet all the appropriate standards.
The ESD valve shall be subject to control from the CCR. Additional shutdown valves shall be located in each supply lines to the gas turbine and the auxiliary boiler.
Shut-off of the gas fuel supply shall be performed by two independently operated automatic shut-off valves; the piping between the valves shall be vented. At least one of the two shut-off valves shall be an automatic fast acting shut-off valve and one shall be a leak tight valve. One of the two shut-off valves may serve as a flow control valve. This shall not be the automatic fast acting shut-off valve which shall be provided as an independent function.
A strainer shall be installed upstream of any automatic fast acting shut-off valve at a suitable location to prevent valve malfunction due to debris entering the valve.
As a minimum each gas fuel supply shall include the following functions:

- a) manual isolation
- b) leak tight shut-off shall fail closed by permanent available energy e.g. spring force.
- c) automatic fast acting shut-off shall fail closed by permanent available energy e.g. spring force.
- d) flow control
- e) venting for depressurization between leak tight and automatic fast acting shut-off valves and
- f) venting for pipework depressurization
Custody meters shall be provided for custody metering of imported Fuel Gas.
The plant shall be designed and operated so that:

The Back-up Fuel system shall include, but not be limited to the following:
- 2x100% unloading pumps with necessary platforms suitable for 2 tankers
- Storage tanks of 24 hours full load operation capacity of EDG
- Treatment facility as required
- 2x100% forwarding pumps for the gas turbines including inlet filters
- 2 x 100 % forwarding pumps including inlet filters for emergency diesel generators, black start facility and firefighting pumps
- Drain collection tank and disposal pumps
- 2x100% Metering Facilities
- Final filters if required
- Related electrical facilities, instrumentation and control, etc.
A slope oil tank shall be provided to enable draining of all piping network.
As a minimum each liquid fuel supply shall include the following functions:
- a) manual isolation
- b) flow control
- c) automatic fast acting shut-off
- d) leak tight shut-off
- e) spill and/or drain
- f) fuel pump
Shut-off valves shall fail close by permanent available energy e.g. spring force. The fail-safe status of drain valves shall minimize any risks.
For operation during maintenance activity or by fire service personnel a valve that is capable of manual operation shall be fitted to the inlet of each gas turbine installation upstream of the automatic valves. This valve shall be clearly marked located in an accessible position and should be capable of being operated by an acceptable level of physical force.
An automatic shut-off valve shall be located outside the gas turbine package to automatically isolate the fuel supply to the gas turbine in the event of a dangerous situation. A filter/strainer shall be fitted upstream of the fuel flow control device and automatic fast acting shut-off valve at a suitable location to prevent device or valve malfunction due to debris entering the device or valve. Where liquid fuel is used suitable drain points shall be incorporated to drain off unburnt fuel from the pressure section of the casing and/or exhaust system (e.g. in the event of a flame failure on start-up). The drain points shall have valves preferably automatically operated that open on shut-down and close as part of the start sequence.
EPC Contractor shall provide necessary back-up fuel facilities required to provide instantaneous on-load change-over from Natural Gas to Back-up Fuel to ensure the Contractor Guaranteed Power Capacity on Back-up Fuel without interruption in the event of a Gas Operation Failure, trip of Gas Connection Facilities or any other scenario that would cause interruption of natural gas supply.

chunks.text:
Contractor in its proposal shall demonstrate that it has carried out design studies to ensure that a successful fuel changeover may be achieved in the event of loss or disturbance of the fuel gas supply. If any loss of power output is predicted during fuel changeover, Contractor must specify this in the proposal.
Necessary  back-up  fuel  facilities  shall  include  duplicate  fuel  forwarding  pumps,  each  of  one  hundred percent (100%) capacity for each gas turbine. Back-up fuel recirculation facilities allowing manual and automatic Back-up fuel recirculation shall be provided.
To ensure that gas pressure can be monitored in the Plant the Contractor shall install a pressure sensor on the Gas line downstream of the Gas Connection Facilities to provide data into the Plant DCS. The DCS shall be configured to provide falling gas pressure and low gas pressure alarms and incorporate suitable control logic to carry out an automatic change over from Natural Gas to Back-up Fuel. The changeover pressure should be set differently for each gas turbine to avoid any negative impact on both, Natural Gas and Backup Fuel resulting in loss of energy generation.
Back-up fuel storage capacity for the Plant shall be increased to cover at least five (5) days back-up fuel demand for the continuous operation of the Plant based on Guaranteed Power Capacity on Back-up Fuel. If required,  Demineralised  Water  Storage  of  not  less  than  five  (5)  days  shall  be  kept  for  water  injection necessary  to  limit  NOx  emission  as  per  the  statutory  environmental  regulations. chunks.text:
The gas turbines shall be capable of start-up, shutdown and continuous operation on natural gas over the whole range of ambient conditions expected at site. The gas turbines shall be capable of online change-over from Simple Cycle to Combined Cycle and vice-versa and from natural gas to back-up fuel and vice-versa without the need to shut down.
In case the GT is provided with fuel gas preheating, the outage of the preheater shall not lead to a GT trip.
The gas turbine shall operate over the frequency range and contribute to governor response to frequency excursions as per the grid code  requirements (if any) or as per agreed with Offtaker and include inlet augmentation system to increase gas turbine output during periods of high ambient temperatures and low relative humidity (if applicable).
The gas turbine generator shall be capable of withstanding 100% load rejection to house load.
All gas turbine compartment enclosures shall be ventilated with filtered air. Ventilation shall be by means of 2 x 100% or 3 x 50% fans with automatic switch-over in case of failure of one fan.
Since GT will be purged before start-up considering NFPA requirement, OEM's standard design does not include gas detector in exhaust duct. An alarm shall be provided to warn the operator of failure of the enclosure ventilation system.
Permanent equipment (piping and valves) for both on-load and off-load compressor cleaning shall  be provided for the Gas Turbine, allowing for the connection of stationary washing equipment. One (1) set of common GT compressor washing equipment shall be supplied for each Group. Permanent effluent disposal systems shall be provided, complying with the local environmental requirements. The Contractor shall detail  on-load  and  off-load  procedures  for  wet  cleaning  of  the  compressor.  Suitable  storage  shall  be provided for off load washings prior to disposal off site. For compressor on-load and off load washings, skid tank shall be provided.
The gas turbine shall be provided with all associated ancillary plant and systems for the safe, efficient and reliable operation of the units in combined cycle mode.
Each gas turbine shall be provided with their starting unit (SFC) from MV switchboard of its own unit / block. In case of non-availability of SFC of that unit, the gas turbine shall be capable of starting from SFC of other unit and facility for such operation shall be considered in the design. The gas turbine shall be provided with a full set of automatic control and protection equipment incorporating governor, temperature control and supervisory functions. Vibration levels shall conform with the relevant ISO standards.
label: text

chunks.text:
The gas turbines to operate in simple cycle shall be complete with by-pass stacks, silencers, and suitable diverter dampers with seal air systems, horizontal and vertical sealing guillotine damper. By-pass stack will  be  designed so  that  there  is  not  any  hot  exhaust  gas  leakage  to  atmosphere  during  combine cycle operation.
Associated ancillary plant and systems shall be provided to ensure the safe, efficient and reliable operation of  the  gas  turbine  in  combined  cycle  mode.  Moreover,  the  Contractor  shall  provide  pulse-type  on-line cleaning (with proven operational performance) of each gas turbine intake filter.
The Gas Turbine control system shall incorporate an interface with the DCS to facilitate integrated control of HRSGs and Steam Turbine (ST) for important and critical operational maneuvers.
Each GT shall also be capable of coming to rest without bearing or other damage on loss of cooling water or main AC power to its oil systems.
Each  Gas  Turbine  shall  be  provided  with  a  full  set  of  automatic  control  and  protection  equipment incorporating  governor,  temperature  control  and  turbine  supervisory  functions.  Vibration  levels  shall conform to the relevant ISO standards.
Lifting gear, such as lifting beams, slings, jacks etc. required for removing complete compressor-turbine rotor, Generator rotor, the upper portion of casings and other heavy equipment shall be provided. (In Gas turbine package, the lifting beams for the generator rotor will not be provided because the rotor is installed or removed by using rotor saddle which will be provided as the generator special tools.
Also, slings, jacking etc. will not be provided because they are not special tools but general tools.
Means shall be provided for powered turning of the rotors for a sufficient period following  normal or emergency shutdown to ensure satisfactory cooling of components. It shall not be possible to start the turning gear without adequate lubrication oil supplies.
Jacking facilities shall be provided for all turbine and generator bearings (if required).
As a backup to the powered system, means shall be provided for turning of rotors during maintenance
Since rotor of M501JAC is so heavy that hand turning is not applicable, hand turning device will not be provided, while OEM should provide means for increment rotation of turbine shaft during maintenance.
In case of black out, AC power should be supplied from EDG to AC turning device.
Gas turbine and generator units should be equipped to provide conservation conditions during outage periods.
Gas turbine package shall include online/offline oil purifier system.
Regardless of Gas turbine package own compressed air supply, the package shall be connected to plant compressed air system for reliable supply of compressed air.
label: text

chunks.text:
The axial flow compressor shall have sufficient aerodynamic flexibility to permit satisfactory operation of the turbine under all conditions, with a safe margin for blade fouling and erosion:
Bleed valves and variable geometry guide vanes shall be a feature of the design to permit more efficient part  load  operation  and  to  avoid  compressor  surging  or  any  other  undesirable  flow  conditions  at  low compressor speeds.
All blading shall be capable of being inspected by fibre optic/borescope techniques via easily accessible, removable port plugs. Inspection holes for Borescope  should be provided as per  OEM standard. Some blades and nozzles in compressors without port plug are inspected with a major inspection.
label: text

chunks.text:
The turbine shall have a robust combustion system designed for maximum life between inspections and repairs. The combustion chambers shall be made of material resistant to very high temperatures with the burners designed to give a stable flame through the entire operating range.
The system shall be capable of achieving the emission limits of NOx and CO without excessive levels of combustion pressure fluctuations. Dry low NOx combustion shall be utilized.
During the starting sequence of a gas turbine, it is essential that the presence or absence of flame is known. Hence, a reliable flame monitoring supervisory system (having triple redundancy) shall be provided.
The flame detection will be performed by software monitoring of trend of blade path temperature in the GT control system during GT startup period. Hence, the flame detectors will not be provided. While the gas turbine is in load operation, the flame loss trip will be conducted with supervising reverse power condition of the gas turbine.
label: text

chunks.text:
The turbine shall be of multi-stage design able to accept sudden load changes and to respond quickly to load fluctuations.
Blade and nozzle materials shall have proven capability when operating at the base load and peak load gas temperatures. It shall be possible to replace blades without having to remove any other blade (except the diametrically opposite blade) and to rebalance the rotor.
All the blades and nozzles shall be capable of being inspected by borescope via inspection plugs on the casings or some other convenient means which does not require major disassembly of the machine.
All hot gas path components shall be designed for long life between inspections and repairs.
The stator carrier ring shall be 12Cr minimum or stainless steel (if applicable).
label: text

The system shall be complete in all respects and shall include cylinders, cylinder racks, piping, valves, nozzles, detectors, fire alarm actuating system, and all other equipment necessary for the safe and efficient operation of the units.
The fire protection and detection system provided with the gas turbine will need to interface, and connect to,  the  main  fire  protection  and  detection  system.  Hazardous  gas  detectors  and  fire  detectors  shall  be provided in enclosure and shall be designed to pick up casing leaks.

The selected Gas Turbine shall be capable of the Continuous emission compliant operation at low loads (60% or below of rated Gas Turbine load).

chunks.text:
Each Gas Turbine shall be equipped with a high efficiency, high-level air inlet filter unit and intake silencing.
The Gas Turbine intake air filtration system shall be two stage inlet air filtration system consisting of pulse cleaning type filter stage and fine filter stage suitable for plant location with high dust laden and humid. The type of filter element selected shall be capable of operating satisfactorily (i.e. delta p across filter shall be such that an acceptable margin from the surge-line shall be achieved at all times. The design operational life of self-cleaning filters and or static final filters shall be a minimum of two calendar years or 16000 gas turbine fired hours, whichever comes first. (for HEPA filter, above requirement is fulfilled. For pulse filter, filter life is dependent on the site environmental conditions and filter maintenance frequency).
The Contractor shall carry out air sampling on Site as is necessary to ensure the correct design of the intake filters  and  their  design  life.  Such  study  shall  be  conducted  in  the  dry  period  of  the  year  when  the concentration of airborne dust tends to be the highest due to seasonal activities and when high mist or visible fog is present with relative humidity reaching 100%. It shall be possible to operate the pulse-clean system without shutting down or reducing power output on the associated unit.
It  should  be  ensured  that  any  cooling  system  is  properly  designed  so  to  provide  the  required  cooling capacity at Reference Site Conditions.
At Project Take Over Stage, EPC to demonstrate clearly that reference site conditions and corrections are modelled  and  applied  in  a  manner  that  shall  satisfying  the  plant  technical  limits  as  per  contractual obligation without any deration.
The selection and design of the air filtration system shall be such as to ensure that sand, water droplets, dust  and  other  harmful  contaminants  in  the  ambient  air  be  filtered  out  to  a  level  which  will  not  be detrimental to the life of the Gas Turbine unit under the most adverse ambient conditions at Site when the plant is operating continuously at maximum output, with the necessity for blade cleaning reduced to a minimum.
The number of access points and penetrations into the air inlet system for maintenance and inspection shall be minimized. Any door or hatch shall be capable of being securely air-tight locked, and interlocks shall be provided to prevent any attempted start of the Gas Turbine with any door or hatch not properly closed.
Particular attention shall be paid to the structural materials and paint used for the construction of the air filtration plant in view of the extensive temperature deviations and climatic conditions. Rain hoods shall be provided on any horizontal air filter inlets.
Silencing shall be provided as required in the inlet system in order to meet the specified noise limits.
label: text

The  steam  turbine  high  pressure  (HP)  section  and  intermediate/low  pressure (IP/LP) section shall be designed for maximum efficiency and to guarantee the maximum reliability and performance.
Design shall ensure a long creep life, suitable for cyclic duty and fast start-up. Last stage blade materials and exhaust steam wetness shall be selected to minimize blade erosion and vibration. The ultimate and penultimate LP stages blade design shall have been proven in service.
Design and testing shall be according to international standards and include balancing and vibration tests.
The Steam Turbine shall conform to the requirements of IEC 60045-1 or EN60045-1 latest version available at the time of EPC Contract.
The steam turbine shall be provided with all TIL's incorporated into design and OEM shall provide the TIL's. The EPC Contractor shall  implement  all  TILs  until  the  end  of  warranty  period.  (TIL  means  (Technical Information Letter) provided by OEM for their specific machines.)

chunks.text:
The turbine shall be a reheat, multiple pressure condensing type using an air-cooled condenser and be suitable for direct coupling to a two-pole generator for power generation at 60 Hz. Designs for impulse or reaction blading, or for combinations thereof, are equally acceptable.
The steam admission to the HP turbine section shall be via suitable stop and control valves. The steam turbine governor shall be capable of controlling the steam turbine to maintain stable conditions.
label: text

chunks.text:
The steam turbine shall be capable of withstanding partial and full load rejection without an overspeed trip and reverse power trip.
The  steam  turbine  shall  be  protected  against  water  ingress.  The  recommended  practices  stated  in ANSI/ASME TDP-1- 2013 shall be provided as a minimum.
Vacuum pumps shall be provided for air extraction from the steam turbine condenser.
Steam turbine bypass provision shall be provided by means of a pressure reduction and desuperheating station between each HRSG superheater outlet and the steam turbine condenser. To facilitate start-up of the Plant, to reduce the impact on steam turbine trips and to improve operational flexibility, e.g. during rapid load changes, steam bypass lines for HP, IP and LP steam shall be installed from each header to the cold reheater or condenser as applicable. Each bypass line shall be designed to handle the full steam flow at all operating points. The bypass shall be automatically initiated in response to high HP steam pressure or as part of an automated steam turbine start-up sequence.
The STG unit shall be able to continue operation when one of the GTs trips.
Inspection  of  highly  stressed  and  back-end  ST  stages  must  be  possible  through  adequate  boroscope openings without opening the casing.
In  order  to  protect  the  ST  from  corrosion  during  standstill  periods,  one  dehumidification unit shall be provided. This dry preservation unit shall blow heated dry air through pre-determined openings to various sections  of  the  ST  and  the  condenser.  The  drying  unit  shall  have  adequate  performance  to  reduce  the moisture  content  of  the  ST  hall  suction  air  to  the  requirement  of  STG/Condenser  OEM  requirements. Automatic control by a hydrostat shall be provided.
A turning gear (automatically engaged and disengaged type) shall be provided to rotate the turbine rotor slowly prior to start-up and after the turbine is shutdown to allow unified warm-up or cooling, maintain eccentricity and to prevent thermal distortion of the rotor. The turning gear pinion shall be engaged only after the rotors have come to rest as indicated by the zero speed indicator and observation.
A pressure switch shall be provided in the turning gear circuit so that loss of bearing oil pressure shall automatically stop the turning gear motor.
- Manual hand turning can be applicable,
- AC Turning Motor shall be supplied

chunks.text:
The blading shall be specially constructed to avoid the possibility of damage from vibration under any condition  of  running,  including  testing  overspeed  trips.  The  blading  shall  further  be  constructed  to withstand the high temperature shocks met with in practice and to resist deterioration through contact with the steam conditions expected during Plant service life.
All blading shall be of proven design and shall feature the following blade strength characteristics:
- For rotating blades with a natural frequency of less than seven (7) harmonics of rotating speed (420 Hz), tuned blades shall be applied which offer sufficient deviation from the resonant frequency;
- For rotating blades with a natural frequency of greater that seven (7) harmonics, un-tuned blades may be proposed but the Contractor shall use its operating experience to ensure that such blades will have sufficient strength margin to withstand resonant vibrations.
Notwithstanding the above, equipment shall comply with any electrical Network Connection Conditions in relation to maintaining operation during network frequency excursions.
The design of blade and its root fixing as well as the material of construction shall have been used in similar applications and at similar operating conditions for a period of not less than 5 years commercial operation without serious incident.
Blading material and design shall be selected with regard to the operating conditions during all normal operation at full load and part load.
HP and IP Blading: The HP and IP stages shall consist of high-performance blades. These blades shall be designed using the latest flow analysis around the blade. The blades shall be of ISB, or integral shroud blade, i.e.  shrouds  and  blade  profile  shall  be  manufactured  from  one  piece,  not  separately  manufactured  and assembled.

The steam stop and throttle valves shall be constructed of material chosen to resist deterioration due to high steam temperatures and erosion. The valves shall be of the 'fail safe' type, arranged to close under spring force and to require hydraulic pressure, under governor control, to open. The main stop valves shall be fitted with internal bypass valves or pilot valves to permit them to be opened against full steam pressure. Provision shall be made for exercising all stop valves and throttle valves with the turbine on full load.
All main inlet and control valves shall be provided with facilities for on-load testing. Positions for all valves, steam pressures and temperatures shall be brought into the DCS.
The turbine shall have two HP stop and control valves and two IP stop and control valves, HP valves shall be  combined  in  a  common  casing  valve  body  directly  connected  to  the  turbine  casing  and,  driven  by hydraulic servomechanism, IP stop and control valves shall be as per OEM design.
The steam strainer cylindrical in shape fits around the valve.

- The Steam Turbine shall be provided with fast cooling system (forced air cooling system) on the main steam control valve and on the reheat steam control valve. The logic to operate the system shall also be implemented. The system shall be designed to achieve a cool down time of less than 3 days.

chunks.text:
In order to protect the steam turbines from foreign object damage, the Contractor shall undertake boiler steam blowing with agreed target plates and install temporary steam strainers at the stop valves which shall  prevent  that  passage  of  foreign  objects  larger  than  4mm  during  commissioning.  Following commissioning, the temporary steam strainers shall be removed by the Contractor and the stop valves shall be fitted  with permanent steam strainers designed as an integral part of the turbine stop valves. Such permanent strainers shall prevent the passage of foreign objects larger than 7mm while ensuring that the valve pressure loss is not excessive. Alternatively a dynamic separator shall be installed on the elbow of the main steam(HP/IP) line in front of main valves, to remove particles and contaminants by inertial forces.
Alternatively, radial flow blade type strainers with a maximum slot width of 0,762 mm (that can withstand high differential pressure and in normal operation has a small pressure drop due to the diffuser action) may be used during commissioning and as permanent protection after suitable cleaning.
label: text

chunks.text:
The lubricating oil system shall provide cooled and filtered oil under pressure to all of the bearings of the turbine and generator. The system shall comprise as a minimum:
- an oil reservoir,
- main and standby full duty oil pumps,
- 2x100% AC motor driven turning oil pump sufficient for extended barring and an emergency DCdriven oil pump. The main oil pump may be shaft driven or motor driven. The standby full duty pump shall be AC motor driven.
- Sufficient  Heat exchanger (minimum 2X100%) (to be designed and implemented according to study results, meeting OEM recommendations for maintain lube oil cooling and serving all worst case conditions)
Lubricating oil pressure shall be automatically controlled either actively or passively.
Low lubricating  oil  pressure  shall  start  the  standby  pumps  as  appropriate  or,  if  a  minimum  adequate pressure is not maintained, shall trip the turbine.
Duplex filters and coolers shall be provided to allow on-line changeover and cleaning of standby equipment.
Oil temperature leaving the coolers shall be automatically controlled.
The oil reservoir shall be supplied with two 100% duty exhaust fans to maintain a depression in the oil return pipework and bearing pedestals. The exhaust from the fans shall be ducted to a safe location outside the building.
Oil leakages shall be contained and prevented from entering the surface water drainage system.
The lubricating oil system shall be common for the steam turbine and the generator. Oil piping from oil strainer/filter to bearings should be Stainless Steel material, oil piping from bearings to lube oil tank should be Carbon Steel material. To eliminate galvanic corrosion between dissimilar materials, EPC contractor should consider special gaskets, bolts and nuts for such connection as applicable.
It is required that lubrication oil supply system and control oil supply system shall be separated. Control oil system and lubrication oil system shall be supplied from separate tanks.
All  oil  systems shall  be flushed after the completion of installation. The oil is circulated from the tank, through the associated pipe systems and coolers to the lube oil system of the steam turbine and back to the tank again. The process is performed in accordance with the prescribed terms of pressure and flow rate. Bearings are to be bypassed during the lube oil flushing by installing a temporary hose at the return line of the lube oil to the tank. The cleanliness level of the oil is analysed by using a comparison contamination kit as well as an electric particle counter measuring instrument. The oil is to meet the specified criteria for optimal system cleanliness.
label: text

chunks.text: Mobile  oil  purifier-separator  of  the  centrifugal  type  shall  be  provided  for  the  Plant.  It  shall  be  easily connectable to each of the oil reservoirs as required using permanent connecting points for supply and return flows as well as drain and or waste oil flows. The oil purifier-separator shall be capable of removing varnish. EPC Contractor is free to propose one mobile oil purifier-separator for 2 GTs and one mobile oil purifier-separator for 2 STs.
